verdicts.reason: A breaks the card set: the Reykjavik card is smaller and sits higher than the other two, the subhead is pulled out of the headline group and stranded at the bottom middle beside the CTA, and the logo and cards crowd the top edge, so the layout reads as a jumble. B keeps the original structure and the three cards stay consistent, but it is mostly a shrunk copy: there are wide dead side margins, the logo, subhead and CTA text are small, and the orphaned 'out' remains.
